mine.title: Keep this dashboard honest
mine.next: Regenerated 2026-07-25 17:32 UTC from the project files, log.md and live gh data — 11 minutes after the previous generation, and it still found three wrong numbers: qlever-dir's label counts included a closed issue, "all 27 issue comments from the owner's account" counted two pull-request comments one of which was Copilot's, and the standing measure counted an issue filed ten days before this chamber existed. Four standing rules now: never bake a relative date into a static file, state wall-clock ages instead; check a public surface the way a reader receives it; put the next decay date on a freshness surface, not just the regeneration date (this one's is tonight at 22:17:48 UTC); and never write a generated timestamp later than the clock — the previous generation was stamped 17:30 and pushed at 17:21
